description: Place names and coordinates for a postcode. GB adds district, ward and constituency (postcodes.io); other countries use Zippopotam.us for ZIP and postal codes. A postcode that does not exist answers 404, not charged. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
